mandatories.value: The product name **Meltemi Fizz** is always written in Latin script, in full. Never transliterated, never abbreviated to "Fizz".
mandatories.anchor: The product name **Meltemi Fizz** is always written in Latin script

mandatories.value: Logo clear space: minimum 1× the height of the wordmark on all sides.
mandatories.anchor: minimum 1× the height of the wordmark on all sides

mandatories.value: Primary palette: Aegean Blue #1B4F8A, Citrus Yellow #F5C518.
mandatories.anchor: Primary palette: Aegean Blue #1B4F8A, Citrus Yellow #F5C518.

mandatories.value: Backgrounds must not use gradients over photography.
mandatories.anchor: Backgrounds must not use gradients over photography.

mandatories.value: Permitted: "zero sugar", "φυσικά συστατικά" (per approved ingredient list).
mandatories.anchor: Permitted: "zero sugar", "φυσικά συστατικά" (per approved ingredient list).

mandatories.value: **Not permitted:** any health or weight-loss claim
mandatories.anchor: **Not permitted:** any health or weight-loss claim

mandatories.value: **Not permitted:** any comparison naming a competitor brand.
mandatories.anchor: any comparison naming a competitor brand

mandatories.value: No alcohol association of any kind (imagery, occasions, co-branding).
mandatories.anchor: No alcohol association of any kind (imagery, occasions, co-branding).

mandatories.value: Avoid generic "beach party" clichés; the brand leans premium-everyday, not spring break.
Confident, modern Greek with natural use of English category terms. Humor allowed; sarcasm about competitors is not.
mandatories.anchor: Humor allowed; sarcasm about competitors is not.

open_questions.gap: The permitted claim "φυσικά συστατικά" is allowed only 'per approved ingredient list', and that list is not part of the guidelines excerpt.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Copy using this claim can only be cleared if we know exactly which ingredients the approved list covers.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Μπορείτε να μας στείλετε την εγκεκριμένη λίστα συστατικών, ώστε να επιβεβαιώσουμε πού επιτρέπεται το claim «φυσικά συστατικά»;

open_questions.gap: The guidelines phrase the 'beach party' point as 'avoid' and the tone section as 'guidance', so it is unclear whether these are firm rules or preferences.
open_questions.why_it_matters: A firm no-go limits the creative territory, while a preference leaves room to explore it.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Οι οδηγίες για τα κλισέ «beach party» και για τον τόνο (χιούμορ ναι, σαρκασμός για ανταγωνιστές όχι) είναι απαράβατοι κανόνες ή κατευθυντήριες γραμμές;
